tests.name: generate-daily-matches excludes test/service accounts (source pin)
tests.reason: Edge-function-only change: the frontend build is unchanged, and the function reaches the live Supabase project only by a manual supabase-functions-deploy dispatch (the push path is frozen since the staging-first cutover). Calling the function generates matches (a write), which a read-only staging probe must not cause. The suite pins that both allowlists are read and removed from the candidate pool before scoring.
